title: Arrays are shared, not copied
prompt: Earlier you saw that a number passed to a function is a copy. Arrays are different. Write `add_item`, which takes an array and appends 99 to it. In `solve`, call add_item(items). Then return items: the original now contains the 99.
hints: Both names point at the same array, so changes made through one show up in the other.
`func add_item(arr):` with `arr.append(99)`; it does not need to return anything.

docs.name: list.append(value)
docs.what: Adds value to the end of the array. Returns nothing.
